methodology.hypothesis: Test the destination of removed equity/gold risk without changing the source's trend decisions. Keep monthly 63/126/252-session relative-to-BIL component scales and original risk budgets exactly; route its already unallocated BIL portion into qualifying actual Treasury funds using two previously defined defensive selection methods.
methodology.selection: At each original fully informed source month end, IEF/TLT qualify only if their 126-session adjusted return strictly exceeds actual BIL over the same horizon. Equality fails. The highest method selects the larger return, then lexical ticker; the diversified method uses 63-session inverse sample-volatility weights for all eligible Treasuries. No qualifying asset leaves original BIL unchanged. Reuse 126/63 and both methods; the Treasury-only subset is fixed before outcomes so a failed gold trend is not silently reintroduced through defense.
methodology.controlledtargets: Leave every original four-style/SOXX/GLD weight and decision date unchanged, including zero-risk states. Replace only original BIL residual with selected IEF/TLT weights; no equity/gold renormalization or new daily covariance/floor/macro guard. Total 98% investment/2% target cash is retained. Changed NAV can change actual dollar holdings of unchanged targets; this is not an equal-risk or causal-attribution guarantee.
methodology.risks: Treasury duration can lose, especially during inflation/rate rises; positive past relative returns do not guarantee safety, independent alpha or 15% drawdown. In a no-eligible state hold actual BIL. No extra zero-cost controls, return forecasts, threshold/lookback/share grid, post-failure tuning or synthetic bond/risk-free returns.
methodology.execution: Exactly the same 122 fully informed monthly source decisions; USD10,000 fresh 10y/5y capital, 5bp next-open base/20bp extra-session stress, USD1/order, fractional long-only cash-funded accounting. Original 2512/1254-session calendars, net excess-return Sharpe definition, SPY/stress-base-SPY/15% drawdown gates are all required.
methodology.provenance: Reuse the original audited 12-asset market, Treasury funds and actual source quotes; no new provider data, current holdings or pre-inception history. Parent relative-trend 5y complete passes motivated exposed-history research but 10y failures remain. Prior GLD/TLT/IEF defense code supplies rule motivation, not an assertion that this Treasury-only residual adapter replays its old portfolio weights.
methodology.authority: Existing-factor/risk-allocation constructions, not new family definitions. Original W42 four plans, IJR/PKW quota and forward rules remain. Old selection diagnostics do not correct these candidates or all searches; historical acceptance would still require actual independent future evidence.
